text: Private enterprise should lead economic growth. Lower marginal tax rates and fewer burdensome regulations would let entrepreneurs invest, compete, and hire. Expanding federal programs is the wrong response to sluggish growth.

The claim that private enterprise should lead economic growth is wrong. Lower marginal tax rates and fewer regulations will not deliver broadly shared prosperity. Expanding federal programs is the right response to sluggish growth.
